business.description: Swasth Foodtech India Limited is a company listed on the BSE SME exchange. The company's specific business activities or products are not described in the provided text.

products.name: Rice Bran Oil
products.note: Processed from crude oil; sold in various grades and colors to oil manufacturers and packers in bulk (B2B)

products.name: By-products (fatty acid, gums, spent earth, wax)
products.note: Residue and by-products generated during processing, sold in open market

customers: Re-packers who sell under own brands or in bulk
Players selling edible oil in unbranded or loose form

plants.location: Baro Chowmata Belari, Guskara, Purba Burdwan, Bardhaman, West Bengal, India, 713141

outlook.statement: It is expected that the Company will achieve better operation and financial performance in FY2026.

Business strategies include setting up a packing line at existing manufacturing unit to pack and sell products in own brand in small quantities; addition of sunflower oil, mustard oil, soya oil, and palm oil as additional products; diversifying and increasing market penetration; strengthening marketing network; achieving maximum operational efficiency; strengthening and expanding market position and product portfolio; enhancing experience, knowledge-base and know-how; increasing network of distributors, customers and geographical reach.
